title: Desktop sandbox: env allowlist + honour request.env; never inherit the API process env
description: Evidence: packages/adapters/src/desktop-sandbox.ts:698-701 spawn(argv, {cwd, env: process.env}); measured: a planted secret in the API env is readable via echo; CommandRequest.env silently dropped (e2b:207/daytona:165/box:256/docker:174 all honour it). Do: build child env from an allowlist (PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, LANG, LC_*, TMPDIR, TERM) + request.env; never pass DATABASE_URL/ENCRYPTION_KEY/BETTER_AUTH_SECRET/SCREEN_PROXY_SECRET/SANDBOX_SUPERVISOR_TOKEN/SMTP_URL/*_API_KEY/*_TOKEN; cap stdout/stderr buffers (e.g. 2 MB, truncate with marker) to fix unbounded accumulation; tests in desktop-sandbox.test.ts. AC: adapters tests green incl. new: (a) ENCRYPTION_KEY absent in child env, (b) request.env visible, (c) 10 MB stdout truncated.

context.text: Desktop sandbox child env allowlist (PATH/HOME/USER/LOGNAME/SHELL/LANG/LC_*/TMPDIR/TERM) + request.env honoured; stdout/stderr capped at 2 MB with truncation marker. New tests in desktop-sandbox.test.ts cover ENCRYPTION_KEY absent, request.env visible, 10 MB stdout truncated. Commit f0e19d2 pushed to lane/T-RKZ-004.
